description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. The page file is written by hand. Two identical EscrowOpened events by synthetic-bob have no block_number key at all: a missing block_number is malformed (clause 7), and malformed events are never deduplicated (clause 9), so they count 2 in malformed_dropped. An EscrowReleased with an explicit block_number null is kept and counts (clause 4), and an ordinary EscrowOpened at block 5 counts. Read as null instead, the two bob events would have counted as one open with one copy dropped. Expected: complete true, status complete; covered 0 to 99; gaps none; totals escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1, escrows_refunded 0, channels_opened 0, channels_settled 0; pending_unfinalized 0; duplicates_dropped 0; excluded_other_genesis 0; malformed_dropped 2; by_account synthetic-alice (escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1).
